_README: Annotated baseline for scripts/check-no-fabrication.mjs. Every CURRENT Math.random hit in a customer-fact path is enumerated here: server (routes-*.ts, storage.ts, services/**) AND client/src/** — the rendering layer was added 2026-08-13 because this lint's own rationale names the UI ("we are lying with a confident UI") while scanning only the server, so a component inventing a displayed number never passed under it. category=P0-FIX-PENDING marks a real fabrication that an owning agent must replace with real data — those entries are removed as the fixes land (a fixed call site becomes a STALE entry that FAILS the lint, forcing removal). All other categories (id, jitter, sampling, shuffle, weighted-pick, backoff, algo) are legitimate non-determinism. New non-id/jitter entries require Iris-CTO sign-off. The ratchet only goes DOWN. Curated 2026-06-08 by Iris+Tess.
